purpose: Define OSC and WebSocket as optional named protocol bindings that translate validated messages to/from explicit canonical/runtime surfaces without becoming semantic authorities.

owns: Runtime OSC and WebSocket Bindings semantics

topics.name: Protocol Bindings
topics.purpose: Define OSC and WebSocket as optional named protocol bindings that translate validated messages to/from explicit canonical/runtime surfaces without becoming semantic authorities.

operations.name: Receive protocol message
outputs: validated inert input or explicit operation request

semantics.input_rule: Inbound protocol messages are inert until mapped to explicit input symbols or canonical operations.
semantics.output_rule: Outbound protocol messages require explicit operation/effect authority.
semantics.address_rule: Protocol addresses map through explicit declared mappings; they do not become arbitrary canonical roots.
semantics.osc_boot_rule: OSC input service boot has explicit boot semantics separate from normal Runner autostart.
semantics.websocket_rule: WebSocket connection identity/state is runtime state, not canonical semantic identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Remote sender data never grants authority.

invariants.rule: Network/service identity, binding, lifecycle and authority remain explicit and separate.

hard_gates.condition: protocol message directly executes arbitrary command
protocol address dynamically selects arbitrary canonical root
OSC boot conflated with Runner autostart
WebSocket connection state becomes canonical semantic identity
optional protocol treated as mandatory Core primitive

references.purpose: Inbound messages become validated inert input.
